_instructions: Populate adapters only from a reviewed release artifact; the executor never treats an observed onchain hash as approval.
Each entry is: { "label": "operator note", "address": "0x + 40 hex", "runtimeCodeHash": "0x + 64 hex" }.
Every adapter referenced by a capsule route must be present. recurring-stack routes also require the capsule's immutable ZAPS_ADAPTER.
An empty, absent, malformed, wrong-chain, or incomplete manifest keeps a signing executor fail closed. Watch-only mode reports the gap.
The current Robinhood adapter registry is 0x9E56e444f490C00A6277326A47Cb462E12dF1f17; registry approval is checked independently and is not a substitute for a release-approved hash.
